description: A ten by ten switching matrix: any input can be added into any of the ten outputs

params.text: Adds that row's input into that column's output while it is on, and lights while it is on

inputs.text: The signal that row can add into any of the ten outputs

outputs.text: The sum of every input whose switch in that column is on

notes: every switch comes up off, so nothing reaches any output until at least one switch is pressed
the switch states are saved with the patch
the inputs are added at full level with nothing attenuating them, so several signals routed into one output add to a large voltage
